summary: First iteration comprehensive test of Lovreski dating app. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass (100%), covering auth, profile, feed, likes/matches, chat with free-then-paid message flow, coins, admin stats/payments/reports, RBAC. Frontend: Landing, register, bottom-nav (5 tabs), Discover swipe buttons, Profile page, Admin panel with 4 tabs and analytics chart all render correctly with proper data-testids. Fixed one env file issue (missing newline before EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) that broke /api/translate.

minor.issue: Comment says 'even if premium, we still deduct — matches problem statement' but code only deducts when coins>=cost; premium users with 0 coins send freely. Verify intended behavior vs spec.

action_items: Verify chat coin-deduction rule for premium users vs spec (currently premium+0coins can still send freely because code guards deduction by coins>=cost).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 855 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, chat, admin, feed, coins) for maintainability.
/api/auth/session sets cookie via secure+samesite=none and returns emergent OAuth session_token; frontend also stores it in localStorage as jwt-like. get_current_user handles both. OK.
/api/demo/seed re-seeds only if <15 demo users; fine and idempotent.
/api/admin/users/{id}/deactivate uses users.delete_one (hard delete). Consider soft-delete + audit trail.
MSG_COST includes 'gift'=10 and 'voice'=10 but chat message pydantic only enforces kind; frontend UX needs to signal cost.
/api/translate depends on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY env var — fixed missing newline in .env; test now passes.

Home feed sometimes shows other real-registered test users of same gender because their gender was set to male (my E2E test registered a male user but gender-male testid missing meant a form default was used). Consider adding gender-male/gender-female data-testids on register form for testability.
updated_files: /app/backend/.env (fixed missing newline between CORS_ORIGINS and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY)
test_credentials: Admin: admin@lovreski.ru / LovreskiAdmin2026! ; register random test users via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/demo/seed once during tests; 16 demo profiles (8 male, 8 female) present. Also created ephemeral e2e users during frontend test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Frontend register form doesn't expose gender-male/gender-female data-testids (not required by spec, but adding would help). Home cards use selectors profile-card-{id}, like-btn-{id}, pass-btn-{id} (not btn-like-* as I initially guessed). All admin data-testids (admin-tab-dashboard/payments/reports/users) work. Chart renders via recharts. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY newline fix applied in backend/.env; translate endpoint now works.
rca of the issue: Translate 500 error RCA: backend/.env had CORS_ORIGINS and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY concatenated on the same line (no newline). dotenv parsed CORS_ORIGINS='*'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=... as a single value for CORS_ORIGINS, leaving EMERGENT_LLM_KEY unset, causing KeyError on os.environ['EMERGENT_LLM_KEY']. Fix: inserted newline between the two lines and restarted backend.
